characters.name: Mầm
characters.greeting: Every new word starts with a little hello.

personality.dream: Map every friendly corner
personality.story: Mầm once got lost following a butterfly. Now every new path begins with an invitation for someone shy to come along.
personality.habit: Bounces twice before an adventure

characters.name: Nắng
characters.greeting: A good story always has room for one more friend.

personality.dream: Build a library with no quiet-only rooms
personality.story: Nắng keeps unfinished stories on the lowest shelf, where even the tiniest friend can reach them.
personality.habit: Tilts their glasses when listening

characters.name: Mây
characters.greeting: Take a little courage. Leave a little kindness.

personality.dream: Sail a paper boat through the clouds
personality.story: Mây draws maps with room for detours. The best destination is often a friend who needs company.
personality.habit: Sways as if carried by a breeze

characters.name: Sỏi
characters.greeting: We can build a better sentence together.

personality.dream: Connect every island with a handmade bridge
personality.story: Sỏi's first bridge fell into a puddle. The second became a bench. The third is still carrying friends home.
personality.habit: Nods once before trying again

characters.name: Bếp
characters.greeting: A pinch of imagination makes a lovely story.

personality.dream: Cook a meal for the whole village
personality.story: Bếp counts guests instead of portions. There is always one more bowl warming beside the stove.
personality.habit: Wiggles with delight when food is ready

characters.name: Bông
characters.greeting: There is a whole adventure between these pages.

personality.dream: Collect a story from every friend
personality.story: Bông writes down the stories people think are too small to matter, then gives them a starring role.
personality.habit: Ears bob when a story gets exciting

characters.name: Giọt
characters.greeting: Little sounds can tell a big story.

personality.dream: Make an orchestra from everyday sounds
personality.story: Giọt heard music in a dripping tap. Their pond is now full of tiny instruments waiting for someone to listen.
personality.habit: Leans closer to a new sound

characters.name: Hạt
characters.greeting: Your voice belongs in the conversation.

personality.dream: Sing a duet with every neighbour
personality.story: Hạt used to sing only to flowers. A friendly echo convinced them that even a small voice can fill a valley.
personality.habit: Keeps a little rhythm with their feet

characters.name: Cốm
characters.greeting: A word grows when you give it a connection.

personality.dream: Grow a garden that feeds everyone
personality.story: Cốm names every seed, including the ones that take their time. In this garden, growing slowly is still growing.
personality.habit: Crouches to greet new seedlings

characters.name: Mít
characters.greeting: Some words are happiest side by side.

personality.dream: Solve the mystery of the missing moon biscuit
personality.story: Mít's biggest discoveries are usually small kindnesses. Their notebook has a whole chapter about who leaves flowers on doorsteps.
personality.habit: Raises one eyebrow at a clue

characters.name: Đào
characters.greeting: I saved every word, just for you.

personality.dream: Deliver a letter to the farthest island
personality.story: Đào writes a tiny encouraging note on every parcel. Nobody has worked out who sends them yet.
personality.habit: Gives a little wave at every doorway

characters.name: Dâu
characters.greeting: Let us paint a sentence, one word at a time.

personality.dream: Paint a mural that everyone adds to
personality.story: Dâu never throws away a mixed-up colour. Yesterday's accident might be tomorrow's sunset.
personality.habit: Tilts their head to frame a scene

characters.name: Bơ
characters.greeting: Your ideas deserve a place on the page.

personality.dream: Write a story with twenty-four endings
personality.story: Bơ keeps words like seeds: some need a quiet page, some need a little sunshine, and some need a friend.
personality.habit: Pauses with a tiny thoughtful smile

characters.name: Na
characters.greeting: Let us find the next small step for you.

personality.talent: Making order out of a muddle
personality.dream: Invent a puzzle everyone can solve together
personality.story: Na sorts shells by the memories they hold, which is why nobody else understands the system yet.
personality.habit: Counts little steps under their breath

characters.name: Me
characters.greeting: A deep breath. A kind question. We are on our way.

personality.dream: Fly beyond the peach-coloured horizon
personality.story: Me checks the weather twice and packs three snacks. Being careful has taken them on some wonderfully brave journeys.
personality.habit: Peeks around before taking off

characters.name: Quýt
characters.greeting: There is always another way to get there.

personality.dream: Run a train with room for every friend
personality.story: Quýt once delayed a departure for a sleepy snail. The passengers still call it their favourite journey.
personality.habit: Bobs to the rhythm of imaginary rails

characters.name: Sen
characters.greeting: Small, steady steps will take you far.

personality.dream: Help a shy friend become a mentor too
personality.story: Sen keeps a jar of tiny successes: a first sentence, a brave question, a try-again. It is nearly overflowing.
personality.habit: Sways slowly when listening

characters.name: Trúc
characters.greeting: Let us visit the words we already know.

personality.dream: Plant a forest of shared memories
personality.story: Trúc returns to the same path each morning and always notices something new. Familiar things can still surprise you.
personality.habit: Rocks gently from heel to toe

characters.name: Gạo
characters.greeting: Slow down. Listen for the little details.

personality.favourite: A cushion under the night sky
personality.dream: Name a constellation after the village
personality.story: Gạo falls asleep halfway through a wish and wakes up with a new idea. Their pockets are full of crumpled star maps.
personality.habit: Blinks slowly before a tiny yawn

characters.name: Đường
characters.greeting: Come in. There is a cosy place for your words.

personality.dream: Open an inn on every island
personality.story: Đường remembers how lonely their first night in the village felt. Every guest now finds a welcome pebble on their pillow.
personality.habit: Opens their arms when greeting someone

characters.name: Moca
characters.greeting: A warm cup and a friendly conversation.

personality.dream: Create a drink for every mood
personality.story: Moca can tell when a friend needs conversation and when they just need a warm cup and a quiet place to sit.
personality.habit: Nods softly while a kettle warms

characters.name: Tím
characters.greeting: A tiny change can make everything click.

personality.dream: Repair the village's old story clock
personality.story: Tím believes a patch is a memory you can wear. Every repair leaves something a little more interesting than before.
personality.habit: Ears twitch when an idea arrives

characters.name: Cuộn
characters.greeting: Follow the clues hidden in every paragraph.

personality.dream: Find the village's forgotten first story
personality.story: Cuộn follows footnotes as if they were forest paths. Sometimes they lead to treasure; usually they lead to another friend.
personality.habit: Peeks over a scroll with bright eyes

characters.name: Bụi
characters.greeting: Something wonderful is waiting to be discovered.

personality.dream: Make the woods safe for the smallest visitor
personality.story: Bụi is shy around crowds but fearless when a beetle needs help. Their mushroom hat is a favourite shelter in the rain.
personality.habit: Peeks out, then offers a small wave
